title: Ok enough grinders
text: Ok enough grinders. I bought these for my Mom since she just has the all in one disposable plastic pepper mills you buy in the spice aisle.  These are definitely a step up from those!  But overall you get what you pay for, these look nice enough but their actual grinding quality/output is not great.  If you're an occasional cook who wants to look a bit more polished these are a nice addition to your kitchen.  But if you actually plan on using these mills regularly they will leave you disappointed in their grinding abilities.  Spend a bit more money and get a better set.
